definitions.gloss: just because; only because (with a bad result)
definitions.explanation: After a past verb or a noun with である, the only cause of an unwelcome result: things went wrong simply because of this one thing. The sentence often carries regret.
In 〜と{言|い}わんばかりに and 〜んばかりに: a manner so plain that the person might as well have said or done it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧ばかりに⟦{怒|おこ}られた→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。
examples.english: I got told off just for saying one thing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寝坊|ねぼう}した→寝坊する：16731_nebousuru⟧ばかりに、⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れた→乗り遅れる：04621_noriokureru⟧。
examples.english: Just because I overslept, I missed the train.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ばかりに、⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}けなかった→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some people couldn't go to university only because they had no money.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{泣|な}か→泣く：00655_naku⟧んばかりに⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: He begged, all but in tears.

examples.japanese: ⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{帰|かえ}れ→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}わ→言う：00515_iu⟧んばかりに⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: She looked at the clock as if to tell me to go home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{割|わ}れ→割れる：00907_wareru⟧ん⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれ→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧、⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げた→下げる：00807_sageru⟧。
examples.english: The hall was filled with thunderous applause, and the singer bowed deeply.

notes:
Built on the particle ⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧ with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Verb (た form) + ばかりに: 〜⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ばかりに (just because I did)
- い-adjective + ばかりに: ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧ばかりに (only because it was cheap)
- Verb (⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ stem) + んばかりに / ん⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: ⟦{泣|な}か→泣く：00655_naku⟧んばかりに (all but crying), ⟦{割|わ}れん→割れる：00907_wareru⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧ (thunderous applause)

WATCH OUT:
- Sense 1 is for bad results only. For a good result use ⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧; for a neutral cause use ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ or ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で.
- 〜たばかりに is not 〜たばかり (just did): ⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧だ means I've just arrived.
